clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Kirge Sternhorn sends travelers north to aid Thork at the Crossroads. The journey carries them from Mulgore into the Barrens and the wider struggles of the Horde.

Camp Taurajo is where many tauren first face the Barrens beyond Mulgore. Just past the mountain pass, mystic Kirge Sternhorn watches travelers descend into the dry grasslands. When Sternhorn sees that a traveler is ready to go farther, Kirge points north along the dusty trade route toward the Crossroads.

The tauren of Thunder Bluff and Thrall's new Horde now share their fortunes. Kirge says the two peoples' fates are bound together, and orcs at the Crossroads need reinforcements as they struggle to establish an outpost. At the settlement, Thork welcomes travelers from even the high bluffs, ready to test their strength against the dangers of the savanna.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have foreseen your arrival, young adventurer. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.
I think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.

It is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is good to see that more of our traveler allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.
